edits.new:
Then when the record cannot be written the call returns 503 with message MSG-P7-003 and no answer

  Scenario: AC10 No business value sits in code (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the delegation_limit table and the reference-data lists hold the rows of version DOA-2026.11
    When a new level row and a new list value are added to delegation_limit and reference data with no build change
    Then the lookup answers the new level and the new value without a change to the build
    Then no level, limit, holder, substitute, product group, regulation item or version is written as a constant in the code

  Scenario: AC11 An unauthenticated or unknown call answers 401 or 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-decision service identity and a caller without a valid credential are the callers of the provided operations
    When a call to GET /api/recovery/access/v1/doa-limits carries no valid credential and a call to POST /api/recovery/access/v1/authorise names an approval that does not exist
    Then the first call answers 401 and the second answers 404, and no authority is granted by either
